The '''weak nuclear interaction''' is one of the four [[fundamental interactions]] between [[quantum particle]]s.

== Properties ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
| Carrier particle
| $W^+,W^-,Z^0$ [[boson]]s
|-
| Participants
| Radioactive particles
|-
| Effective range
| $10^{-18} \mathrm{m}$
|}

<ref>{{#cite:Q2545}}</ref>

== Example interactions ==

=== Neutron decay ===

$$
n \rightarrow p + e^- + \overline{\nu}_e
$$
<div class="center">
{| class="wikitable"
|-
| $n$
| [[Neutron]]
|-
| $p^+$
| [[Proton]]
|-
| $e^-$
| [[Electron]]
|-
| $\overline{\nu}_e$
| Electron [[neutrino]]
|}
</div>
